meta.title: Share of each nearby tract's people within a 10-, 15- and 20-minute drive
meta.source: OpenStreetMap road network routed by OSRM (driving profile), from each tract's 2020 population centre to population-weighted cells of 2020 Census blocks
meta.blocks_source: U.S. Census Bureau, TIGER/Line 2020 tabulation blocks, Colorado (POP20, internal points)
meta.origins: each tract's 2020 population centre (the points of data/market/tract_drive_times_co.json) and each town's and CDP's TIGER 2020 internal point
meta.units: whole percent of the destination tract's 2020 population; free-flow driving, no traffic
meta.odbl_notice: Contains information from OpenStreetMap and OpenStreetMap Foundation, made available under the Open Database License.
limitations: From the nearest origin point (a tract's population centre or a town's internal point): a site some way from every such point may be some minutes nearer to or farther from a given tract.
Blocks are grouped into cells of about 2 km inside each tract; a cell's people share one drive time.
2020 Census population; growth since 2020 is not in the shares.
Free-flow times from the road network; no traffic, season or road closures.
Cells more than 20 straight-line miles from the origin are not routed.
